# Island Ex: the English strings, generated from the Loc.Get calls.
# Do not edit this file: change the English in the code and build again.
#
# To translate, copy it to plugins/IslandEx/Localization/<lang>/strings.txt (jp, cn, kr, ru,
# ptbr, fr ...) and translate the right side of each "=". Keep {0} and {1}, moving them
# where the grammar wants them; \n is a line break; two spaces in a help line separate
# a term from what it means. A key left out falls back to this English.
#
# A count has two lines here, key.one and key.other; Russian adds key.few and key.many,
# Chinese and Japanese need only key.other. loc.separator joins the parts of a hover.
# Keep tooltip labels (the words before a two-space gap) under 28 characters.

badge.off=off  -  click to turn on
badge.on=on  -  click to turn off
badge.turns_off=turns off at the next start  -  click to cancel
badge.turns_on=turns on at the next start  -  click to cancel

keep_broken.broke={0} is broken. It waits in your bag for a repair kit.
keep_broken.broke_dropped={0} is broken. No room in your bag, so it lies at your feet.
keep_broken.refused={0} is broken. A repair kit mends it.
